lore: A short book that knows throwable bricks, heads and other silly joys.
use: The Simple Fun Guide explains throwable bricks, heads and other silly joys. Craft it shapeless from a book and a crafting table.
secret: Its chapters unlock as the matching recipes land in your recipe book. Nothing is consumed.

lore: A snowball with a brick for a heart. Everyone knows it is a bad idea, which is the joke.
use: Craft four snowballs around one brick. Stacks to 16. Thrown, it deals 0 to 4 damage (default 2) with a cooldown of 10 ticks; both have their own server switch.
secret: It is mostly a cosmetic gag: it knocks back and hurts a little, and it breaks no blocks.

lore: Born at a birthday nobody remembers, this paper tube still goes off with the same cheerful pop.
use: Craft paper, string and a dye for two. Use it: confetti in the dye's colour rises (at most 40 particles) with a pop. It is used up, 3 seconds cooldown.
secret: It does nothing but celebrate. No damage, no block changes, and it works in any world where fun is allowed.

lore: Two bone-white cubes that have settled more arguments than any council.
use: Craft two bone meal with black dye. Use to roll 1 to 6, sneak to roll two dice. The server rolls and the number floats above your head and appears in chat within 16 blocks; 1 second cooldown.
secret: Nobody can load them: the roll is made by the server, so even the owner cannot cheat.

lore: A copper coin with a golden nugget in its heart, flipped before more journeys than anyone can count.
use: Craft a copper ingot with a gold nugget. Use it to flip: heads or tails floats above your head and shows in chat within 16 blocks; 1 second cooldown.
secret: It never lands on its edge, and it brings no actual luck. The server flips it.

lore: The flattest stones always lie near water, as if they had been waiting for a thrower.
use: One cobblestone, tuff, andesite or cobbled deepslate makes four. Throw it flat over water and it skips up to five times with a splash and a count; too steep or too slow, it sinks.
secret: Skipping has a record: the longest run is kept as a statistic. It causes no damage and changes no blocks.

lore: A leather skin full of lake and good intentions, made for hot days and hotter pranks.
use: Craft leather, string and a water bucket for four; the bucket stays. It hits players and blocks only: it douses fire, lit candles and campfires within one block, fills a hit cauldron by one level and wets a hit player. 5 second cooldown.
secret: Mobs are safe from it, and in the Nether it only makes steam.

lore: A stick, a loop of string and a cheerful breath: the oldest way to make small rainbows.
use: Craft a stick, string and a water bucket; the bucket stays. Hold use and a soap bubble rises every 0.7 seconds, up to 8 blocks, and pops at a ceiling. At most 12 bubbles per player, 64 uses.
secret: The bubbles are pure particles: they block nothing and carry nothing, so they are safe near redstone and sleepers.

lore: One sheet, a few clever folds, and a very short career as an aircraft.
use: Craft one paper. Throw it: it glides, flies through creatures without harm and lands as an item (it floats on water). Best range is about 20 degrees upward, at most 60 seconds in the air.
secret: Hold a book and quill or a written book in the other hand and its first page (up to 200 characters) is folded into the plane; sneak and use reads the note.

lore: It floats, it squeaks, and it has solved more bath-time problems than any wizard.
use: Craft yellow dye, a slimeball and a gold nugget. Place it on a water surface (like a lily pad) or on solid ground; clicking it squeaks and makes it hop, touching does nothing.
secret: Placed on soul sand it becomes the pirate duck. It is purely decorative and harmless.
